title: Lesson 21. Fetch API and JSON
description: JSON, fetch, promises, .then, .catch and working with data

learn.intro: Hi! Lesson 21 — **Fetch API and JSON**. Real sites get data from a server: weather, products, posts. We'll learn to «go» to the server for data. Let's go!

slides.text: We wrote all the data by hand in code. Real sites get it from a server. **JSON** is the same format as JS objects, only as text. That is how data travels over the internet.
A JS object and the same object in JSON:

check.prompt: JSON is a data format similar to JS objects, but as text.
check.explain: This is how data is passed between a server and a site.

slides.text: `fetch` is a way to «go» to the server and bring data:
`fetch` returns a **promise** — a promise that the data will arrive a bit later, not instantly.

check.explain: A promise — data will arrive later.

slides.text: `.then` — what to do when the result arrives. `response.json()` turns the «raw» response into a JS object. `.catch` catches an error if the server is down or there is no internet.
Cheat sheet: `fetch(url)` — request; `.then(r => r.json())` — turn into an object; `.catch(err => ...)` — an error.
